The case of the petitioner is that he filed Miscellaneous Case No. 32 of 1983 under section 96 of the East Bengal State Acquisition and Tenancy Act against the opposite party pre-emptee for pre-emption of the land of Mouza Delua, SA Khatian No. 831, Plot No. 480 being an area of 0.06 decimals which is a part of total area of 0.34 decimals after depositing the consideration money. 

 6. I have perused the materials on record. The petitioner in his review petition clearly stated that the order of the adjournment cost of Taka 200.00 was not communicated to the lawyer of the petitioner. The lawyer did not know about the order of cost. 

 7. I have considered the facts of the case and the materials on record. I find no reason to disbelieve the statement of the petitioner. Moreover, on hearing about the non-payment of the adjournment cost the petitioner immediately paid the said cost. Besides, even if the petitioner knew about the cost, then also non-compliance with the order of a Court for payment of cost a separate proceeding can be drawn against a defaulting person but such non-payment cannot be a ground to dismiss a suit.
